mutations.name: owned-hub-no-resume
mutations.what: the Hub does not read its standard input

mutations.name: owned-hub-no-listeners
mutations.what: the end of standard input does not stop the Hub

mutations.name: owned-hub-end-listener
mutations.what: the end of standard input does not stop the Hub (no end listener)
mutations.equivalent: a pipe that ends also closes, and the close listener does the same; only the listener that comes first is lost

mutations.name: owned-hub-close-listener
mutations.what: the close of standard input does not stop the Hub (no close listener)
mutations.equivalent: a pipe that ends first emits 'end', and that listener does the same; only the second of the two is lost

mutations.name: owned-hub-error-listener
mutations.what: an error of standard input does not stop the Hub (no error listener)
mutations.equivalent: an error of the pipe is followed by its close, and the close listener does the same

mutations.name: owned-hub-stop-too-early
mutations.what: the stop is signalled before the Hub is up

mutations.name: owned-hub-owner-gone-ignored
mutations.what: an owner that went away during start-up is forgotten

mutations.name: connect-foreign-app
mutations.what: a program that answers on the port as something else is taken for a Hub

patches.old: if (running.app !== APP_ID) throw unavailable(`Port ${port} is used by another program (it answers, but not as a DatGold Hub). The agent does not stop it: choose another port with --port.`);

mutations.name: connect-port-held
mutations.what: a port that something holds is not noticed

patches.old: if (await portOpen(port)) throw unavailable(`Port ${port} is used by another program. The agent does not stop it: choose another port with --port.`);

mutations.name: connect-no-start-ignored
mutations.what: --no-start does not stop a Hub from being started

patches.old: if (!start) throw unavailable(`No DatGold Hub is running on port ${port}, and --no-start was given. Start DatGold, or drop --no-start.`);

mutations.name: connect-listener-unchecked
mutations.what: the secret is sent to whatever listens on the port

patches.old:
try { await assertSessionListener(session, { file: sessionFile(stateDir) }); }
    catch (error) { throw unavailable(`Not sending the Hub's secret: ${error.message}`); }

mutations.name: cmd-bundled-node-path
mutations.what: the launcher looks for the bundled Node in the wrong folder

mutations.name: cmd-bundled-node-ignored
mutations.what: the launcher never uses the bundled Node

mutations.name: cmd-agent-path-unquoted
mutations.what: the path of the agent is not quoted
